bagPolicy.summary: At SMU athletics events, clear bags up to 12" x 6" x 12" and small clutches about the size of a hand are allowed. Other bags and backpacks are not.
allowed: Clear plastic, vinyl or PVC bags up to 12" x 6" x 12"

bagPolicy.note: This is the SMU Athletics policy; concerts may set their own rules. Strollers must be checked at Gate 5. Medically necessary items get a separate screening at all gates.
